title: Test Your ETF Knowledge In Our IQ Test
summary: Bloomberg's Joel Weber puts Scarlet Fu, James Seyffart, and Todd Sohn, ETF strategist at Baird Strategas, to the test on "Bloomberg ETF IQ" in this week's edition of "IQ Test." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: We Will Take Risks If Clients Willing: Legum
summary: Maital Legum, head of ETF solutions at Teucrium, joins Scarlet Fu and James Seyffart on "ETF IQ." They discuss the process the firm goes through as they decide to launch ETFs or not. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bolivia Hikes Diesel Prices for Big Buyers
summary: Bolivia’s government raised diesel prices 84% for larger consumers of the key industrial fuel, following shortages that caused long lines at gas stations.

title: EM Currencies Rise on Softer Dollar and Stronger Risk Appetite
summary: An index tracking developing-world currencies gained Monday as fading bets on a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike next month undercut the dollar and supported risk appetite.
